name: nextpow2
expr: y_v = nextpow2(v); y_z = nextpow2(0); y_neg = nextpow2(-100); y_frac = nextpow2(7.5); y_lt1 = nextpow2(0.5); y_q = nextpow2(0.25); y_cx = nextpow2(3+4i); y_nan = nextpow2(NaN); y_pinf = nextpow2(Inf); y_ninf = nextpow2(-Inf);
comment: Sig: P = nextpow2(N). Smallest p such that 2^p >= |N|. Vectorised. Edges: |x|=0 -> 0; NaN -> NaN; ±Inf -> +Inf; complex z -> uses |z|. Bug fix 2026-05-08: complex input previously threw; NaN/Inf paths now match MATLAB. tol=0.
